lessonTitle: The Brain-Agent Loop: Read, Respond, Remember
opening: You're midway through planning a product launch with your AI assistant. You mentioned the target demographic three weeks ago, outlined the budget constraints in an email last Tuesday, and refined the messaging strategy during yesterday's voice call. Now you ask: *"Should we lead with pricing or value proposition?"* The assistant confidently suggests leading with aggressive pricing, completely ignoring that you explicitly decided on value-first messaging yesterday.
